scientific_choices.choice: Paper sections 3.3/3.5 use segmentation components and PARSeq-S. YOLO localization is a separate APPROXIMATE experiment, not strict reproduction.
Transfer the existing pinned YOLOv8s TextOCR detector, qualified PARSeq artifact, direct RGB crop, normalization and joint confidence/NMS implementation unchanged.
Freeze the 640-pixel detector settings, raw controls and joint 0.6 / same-text NMS 0.5 before inspecting these TEST results. Do not fit parameters or choose a winner on the new TEST splits.

Micro exact normalized transcription and original-axis bbox IoU >=0.5 with maximum one-to-one matching. Casefold and remove Unicode punctuation/symbols; retain spaces. Ignore GT excluded; predictions on ignored regions remain false positives. This is a local proxy, not official polygon Hmean.

ICDAR13 uses the qualified 233-image Task1 manifest; ICDAR2015 uses all 500 prepared test rasters and original quadrilateral transcriptions; CTW1500 uses its qualified 500-image E2E recognition manifest and prepared EXIF-normalized rasters.

CTW1500 GT units are full text lines. Evaluate the existing word detector against those lines without inventing word boxes or using GT to group predictions. Label the resulting exact-line diagnostic separately.
Explicit CPU or GPU, FP32, detector batch1 / PARSeq batch32 and sequential model residency. Save stage-specific GPU peaks and propagate OOM; CPU smoke results do not qualify RTX3070 execution.

Strict PARSeq-S identity, official ignore-aware polygon protocols, external training overlap and target GPU execution remain outside this local transfer experiment. See YTR-001 in docs/PAPER_AMBIGUITIES.md.
